commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible/vlan-segmentation/playbook.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Segment node2/node3 onto tagged VLANs over the shared trunk link
  hosts: linux_hosts
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Bind {{ trunk_iface }} to a VLAN sub-interface
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/10-trunk.network.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/network/10-{{ trunk_iface }}-trunk.network"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Restart systemd-networkd

    - name: Create the VLAN netdev
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/vlan.netdev.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/network/vlan{{ vlan_id }}.netdev"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Restart systemd-networkd

    - name: Address the VLAN interface and route to the peer's VLAN
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/20-vlan.network.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/network/20-vlan{{ vlan_id }}.network"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Restart systemd-networkd

  handlers:
    - name: Restart systemd-networkd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: systemd-networkd
        state: restarted

- name: Configure node1 (VyOS) to route between the two VLANs
  hosts: vyos_router
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    router_trunk_iface: eth1
    ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3
  tasks:
    - name: Render VyOS VLAN configuration script
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/vyos_vlans.sh.j2
        dest: /tmp/vyos_vlans.sh
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Apply VLAN sub-interfaces and commit/save
      ansible.builtin.command: sudo bash /tmp/vyos_vlans.sh
      register: vyos_apply
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_apply.stdout"
EOF
cat /root/ansible/vlan-segmentation/playbook.yml
